title: Resilience and Coping to Promote Well-being
description: Examines what it means to cope well and adapt in an increasingly stressful and complex world. Introduces a multisystems/multicultural perspective of resilience. Interconnectedness of individual and community resources are defined, explored through experiential learning methods. Focuses on sustaining wellbeing through the promotion of healthy relationships.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of CNPY 277, ED-D 277.
